name: happy-path-basic-story
description: Valid story flows through Atlas, Dot, Gil, Dev, and Reed with required contract blocks.

story.title: User can reset password via email link
story.description: As a user, I want to reset my password via a secure email link so that I can regain access.
acceptance_criteria: User requests a reset using a registered email address.
System sends a one-time reset link that expires after 15 minutes.
User can set a new password that meets complexity rules.
Expired or reused links are rejected with a clear message.
constraints: Use the existing email delivery service.
Do not reveal whether an email is registered during the request step.
